| # How to interpret the reset information from a given reset type? {#how-to-interpret-the-reset-information-from-a-given-reset-type-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                                    |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The reset information can be interpreted using the reset type (here represented as Reset Id value) by referring the below table:\
 

  ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Reset Id            RBA_SYC_POWERUNDERVOLTAGE_RSTID_UV_DETECTED
  Reset Id value      0x4000
  Reset description   This reset is caused if a 5V undervoltage was detected via interrupt service routine.
                       
  Reset Id            RBA_SYC_RESET_RESTART
  Reset Id value      0x4001
  Reset description   Reset which can used in Integration Code to \"restart\" the ECU.
                       
  Reset Id            RBA_SYC_RESET_WAKEUP
  Reset Id value      0x4002
  Reset description   Reset because of a Wakeup used in Integration Code and ShutDown
                       
  Reset Id            RBA_SYC_SHUTDOWNSERVICES_RSTID_WAKEUP
  Reset Id value      0x4003
  Reset description   Reset because of a Wakeup used in ShutDown
                       
  Reset Id            ECUM_E_RESET_CONFIGURATION_DATA_INCONSISTENT
  Reset Id value      0x3000
  Reset description   Reset for EcuM_ErrorHook(), in case of Post build configuration pointer is inconsistent
                       
  Reset Id            ECUM_E_RESET_GENERAL
  Reset Id value      0x3001
  Reset description   Reset for EcuM_ErrorHook(), in case of unknown error scenario
                       
  Reset Id            ECUM_E_RESET_INVALID_PTR_RETURNED
  Reset Id value      0x3002
  Reset description   Reset for EcuM_ErrorHook(), in case of Post build configuration pointer is NULL
                       
  Reset Id            ECUM_E_RESET_NULL_PTR_RETURNED
  Reset Id value      0x3003
  Reset description   Reset for EcuM_ErrorHook(), in case of Post build configuration pointer is invaild
                       
  Reset Id            ECUM_E_RESET_RAM_CHECK_FAILED
  Reset Id value      0x3004
  Reset description   Reset for EcuM_ErrorHook(), in case of unknown error scenario
                       
  Reset Id            ECUM_E_RESET_START_CORE_FAILED
  Reset Id value      0x3005
  Reset description   Reset for EcuM_ErrorHook(), in case of any one core failed to start(Applicable only for multicore scenario )
                       
  Reset Id            ECUM_RESET
  Reset Id value      0x3006
  Reset description   Reset for EcuM_AL_Reset() callout
                       
  Reset Id            MCU_RB_RESET_BUSERR_SBCU
